subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only four boxes are kept between C and F. Only A is kept above C. Only two boxes are kept between D and E. G is kept immediately above B. E is not kept immediately above G. How many boxes are kept above G?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only four boxes are kept between C and F.
 
• Only A is kept above C.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between D and E.
 
• G is kept immediately above B.
 
• E is not kept immediately above G
 
• The Final Arrangemnt is 
 
• 
 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 
 
 
 
• 3 boxes are kept above G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
